issues.quote: revenue rising 22.5% to $394.3 billion from $365.8 billion
issues.problem: Growth from $365.8B to $394.3B is about 7.8%, not 22.5%.

issues.quote: which points to some margin pressure as profit lagged sales
issues.problem: This rests on the overstated revenue growth. Revenue grew ~7.8% and net income 5.4%, so net margin only slipped from ~25.9% to ~25.3%.

data.summary: The dollar figures are correct, but revenue growth is misstated as 22.5% when it was ~7.8%, which also exaggerates the margin-pressure conclusion.
